data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'mlk' meaning 'king' or 'sovereign'. In Islamic context, Malikaat refers to the honorable and virtuous women mentioned in the Quran, known for their devotion and faith. The name Malikaat carries the meaning “Queen, Ruler, Sovereign” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Malikaat usually hope their child will grow to embody queen, ruler, sovereign and live with faith, good character and purpose.
